messages:
alina (Design): Pushed a tiny prototype for the preflight step. New ideas: keyboard-first layout (large tap targets), visible focus rings, and a "diagnostic timeline" that shows last probe run + time. Screenshot in thread.

marc (PM): Nice. Two asks: 1) make the timeline optional (collapse by default); 2) change microcopy for failures to explain immediate impact, e.g. 'Blocks agent install' not 'Failure'.

luca (Eng): Timeline collapsed by default is easy. For focus rings I'll make sure we use the brand accent with a 3px outline and a 4px gap so it doesn't clash. Also adding a small keyboard hint: "Press Enter to expand details" on probe rows.

tiffany (DevEx): UX note: copy buttons should be keyboard reachable and show an accessible success message. Propose using an aria-live region that announces "SSH command copied" and shows a check icon for 2s.

a11y-bot: Automated check: current light orange (used for 'Partial') fails contrast (3.0:1). Also flag: focus ring color needs 3:1 contrast vs background for visibility.

alina (Design): I'll pick a darker amber and bump focus ring contrast. Also switching labels to 'Reachable / Partial / Blocked' per previous threads. Adding a small 'Why this matters' inline copy that opens contextual tips.

marc (PM): For diagnostic timeline wording: 'Last checked 3m ago — Run check' where Run check is a button. If run can be triggered by non-admins, add a tooltip: 'May require firewall changes; we won't modify customer infra'.

luca (Eng): Implementation: Run check should set aria-busy on the probe row and announce progress: "Re-running SSH check, 10s remaining" via aria-live. Will add debounce and opt-out for noisy logs.

tiffany (DevEx): QA checklist draft:
- timeline collapsed by default
- visible focus rings on all interactive elements
- copy buttons keyboard accessible and announce success via aria-live
- amber/darker color meets 4.5:1
- probe rows have aria-expanded on toggle and Enter toggles them
- 'Run check' sets aria-busy and announces completion

alina (Design): Perfect. I'll update the mock with focus flow arrows and the collapsed timeline state. Will push frames and tag the PR. :sparkles:
